financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Lind warrant exercise for cash (500,000 warrant shares at $0.42)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: We also reduced our outstanding warrants from 2.5 million shares to 2 million shares in October, receiving around $210,000 in cash.

warrants.quote: Lind also received a 5-year common stock purchase warrant to purchase up to 1,000,000 shares of the Company’s common stock at an initial exercise price of $2 per share for a period of 5 years.
